task: GitHub issue #15: Registry digest in RUN_STARTED + hyphen-tolerant program names

acceptance.criterion: registry_digest() is a deterministic, cheap digest of the builtin command registry over sorted (name, version, effect_class, execution, minimum_tier) summaries
acceptance.evidence: src/tikhon/registry/registry.py registry_digest(); builtin digest 9160b5ecc029cd02da9c109fe578c7e1ec1714c6b82267bc17157addb73381b7 stable across repeated computations

acceptance.criterion: RUN_STARTED event payload carries registry_digest alongside program/version without breaking existing payload-key assertions
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_coordinator.py::test_run_started_carries_stable_registry_digest; existing lifecycle test asserting history[0] is RUN_STARTED still passes

acceptance.criterion: create_run metadata carries the same registry digest
two coordinators with the same registry produce the same digest
changing the spec set changes the digest (extra spec built via the Registry API, builtins untouched)
acceptance.evidence: tests/test_coordinator.py::test_extra_spec_changes_registry_digest uses dataclasses.replace of a builtin spec registered under a new name

acceptance.criterion: tikhon audit does not newly fail on legacy runs whose RUN_STARTED lacks a registry digest
acceptance.evidence: src/tikhon/audit.py confirmed to never read RUN_STARTED (unchanged); tests/test_audit.py::test_audit_clean_on_legacy_run_without_registry_digest audits a hand-built pre-digest run clean

acceptance.criterion: hyphenated program name parses and seals deterministically; leading hyphen or digit rejected; hyphenated step id still rejected; underscore names unchanged
acceptance.evidence: 5 new tests in tests/test_syntax.py; CLI check: PROGRAM a-b-c lints valid and seals to the same digest twice via PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tikhon

acceptance.criterion: SKILL.md updated: hyphen rule for PROGRAM names only, underscore rule kept for step ids and refs (single-sentence edit)
acceptance.evidence: .opencode/skills/tikhon-demo/SKILL.md Program Rules section; git diff shows one replaced sentence

acceptance.criterion: full pytest suite passes with no files outside the allowed set touched
acceptance.evidence: python3 -m pytest -q -> 274 passed (baseline 265); git status shows only parser.py, registry.py, coordinator.py, the three test files, SKILL.md modified, plus demo/runs/issue-15-registry-digest/ added; concurrent agent's untracked files left alone

protocol_deviations: The sealed program uses the underscore program name issue_15_registry_digest because the protocol requires sealing before source edits and the pre-change grammar rejects hyphens; the hyphen-tolerant grammar is verified by tests and a CLI seal of PROGRAM a-b-c.

The installed ~/.local/bin/tikhon console script resolves a stale site-packages copy of tikhon (src-layout repo, pytest injects src via pythonpath); all lint/seal verifications were re-run against repo code with PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m tikhon, and the sealed program's digest is identical under both copies.
